pm_open_01.text: Morning. The plan is locked: dig Day 1, pipe Day 2, backfill Day 5, Standard machines. We promised Day 35 and the budget is two seventy-eight. Permits are posted. Nothing gets bought ahead; it is not in the budget. Call me before you change anything.

pm_prep_refused_01.text: No. We are not buying steel for a hole that has not failed. Not in the budget.

pm_hold_01.text: You are holding a crew that bills eighteen hundred a day. I hope you have a reason.

pm_demob_01.text: Sending a crew home mid-job? Getting them back costs us five thousand and days we do not have.

pm_end_01.text: That is the job. Let us see where the lines ended up against what we promised.

radio_ack_01.text: Copy, office. Passing it to the foreman at the next shift.

radio_notdone_01.text: Office, inspector reports the crew never got it. Say again?

foreman_pipe_arg_01.text: You are on top of me! I have got a wall down at seven-twenty and your loader is pushing dirt onto my bedding.

foreman_back_arg_01.text: The schedule had me here Day 5. I lay two-fifty a day and you lay one-eighty. Where exactly did they think I would go?

foreman_held_02.text: Second day on a hold. My guys are getting paid to watch a trench.

foreman_held_03.text: Three days. Either give me a stretch to fill or send us home.
